ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE toolbar IS

 tbscale NUMBER := 43; -- good for 1024x768 (SVGA)
-- tbscale NUMBER := 40; -- good for 640x480 (VGA)
 item_name VARCHAR2(80);
 PROCEDURE hide_function;
 PROCEDURE set_timer;
 PROCEDURE show_function;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 v_temp varchar2(6);
 v_audit varchar2(6);
 v_date date;
 v_date1 date;
BEGIN

 
 begin /* If a rule is update , the updated date and user is taken from the audit table */
 
 SELECT insert_user,insert_date into v_temp,v_date
 from drive_category_rules where rule_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_rule_id and
 insert_date= (select max(insert_date) from drive_category_rules where rule_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_rule_id)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and rownum=1; 
 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 begin
 SELECT user_id,audit_insert_dats into v_audit, v_date1
 from drive_category_rules_audit where rule_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_rule_id and
 audit_insert_dats= (select max(audit_insert_dats) from drive_category_rules_audit where rule_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_rule_id)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and rownum=1; 

 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 if v_date > v_date1 then
 v_temp:=v_temp;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_updated_dt:=v_date;
 else
 v_temp:=v_audit;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_updated_dt:=v_date1;
 end if;

 begin
 select initcap(user_last_name) || ', ' || initcap(user_first_name)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_last_updated 
 from system_users 
 where user_id=v_temp;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 end;
 ------------------------------------

 go_block('drive_category_rules');
 /* Included :global.chapter_id --01/17/11 */
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_termination='N' then
 set_block_property('drive_category_rules',default_where,'rule_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_rule_id and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and ( term_date is null or term_date >=sysdate)');
 else
 set_block_property('drive_category_rules',default_where,'rule_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_rule_id,rule_id) and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id');
 end if;
 
 execute_query;
 enable_disable('D');

EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 :global.frm_status:='S';
 
/* Check in the database */

 select count(*) into temp from drive_category_rules where
 rule_id=:drive_category_rules.rule_id and drive_category=:drive_category_rules.drive_category
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

 if temp > 0 then
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

/* check in the buffer */

 
 if nvl(:global.rule_id,' ') != nvl(:drive_category_rules.rule_id,' ') or
 nvl(:global.category,' ') != nvl(:drive_category_rules.drive_category,' ') then
 
 check_insert_rg('drive_rg0','C10C05',:global.rule_id||','
 ||:global.category||',','D',check_dup); 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('drive_rg0','C10C05',:drive_category_rules.rule_id||','
 ||:drive_category_rules.drive_category||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('0319');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('drive_rg0','C10C05',:drive_category_rules.rule_id||','
 ||:drive_category_rules.drive_category||',','U',check_dup);
 
 end if;

END;

 else

 end if;
 execute_query;
 enable_disable('D');
 ---set_block_property('drive_category_rules',insert_allowed,property_false);
 ---set_block_property('drive_category_rules',update_allowed,property_false);
END;

BEGIN

 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_rule_id',pl_mode);

 else

 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_lov',enabled,property_true);
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 elsif error_code = 41008 --list not available

 ---------- Following added by Mukesh 05/28 --------------
 elsif error_code = 41009 --Function key not allowed
 then

 elsif error_code = 41051 --Can not create records here
 then

 ----------------------------------------------------------
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update

 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');

 then

 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 format_error;

 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then

 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 format_error;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
